findings.title: Lithuanian totpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The Lithuanian translation of `totpStep1` is now an Italian sentence ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:"). Lithuanian users will see Italian in the TOTP setup step. Replace it with a Lithuanian translation, or remove the key so it falls back to English.

findings.title: zh_CN totpStep1 uses Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: The Simplified Chinese bundle now has a Traditional Chinese string ("在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一："). Its other strings are Simplified. Use the Simplified form (在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：), or copy the zh_TW text only into the zh_TW bundle.

findings.title: Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1` in the Lithuanian login bundle is now Italian ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:"). Lithuanian users will see Italian text on the OTP setup page. Use a Lithuanian translation, or drop the key so it falls back to English.
